{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment turns positive after negativity, forecast prices should lag behind true outcomes by 1-2 days to account for market adjustment time",
    "Sentiment-based price rebounds are mean-reverting and should be capped at 95% of the model's peak forecast to prevent unrealistic overshoot",
    "Prices below the 30-day moving average require forecast compression by 0.5-1.0 points per day until alignment is reached",
    "When history shows high volatility (std > 2.0), reduce forecast sensitivity to current sentiment by 30-50%",
    "Model forecasts overshoot true outcomes at 15-20 day horizons by 0.3-0.6 points daily; apply gradual convergence factor of 0.97 per day",
    "Negative sentiment periods require forecast floor at 95% of current price to prevent unrealistic price depression",
    "Mismatch between forecast trend and short-term price momentum indicates model lag; adjust 10-20% toward immediate price action for first 7 days of forecast horizon"
] }
